notification_destination: La Maison Santa Barbara Slack #automations (C0C7XQK3TTR); ChatGPT fallback if Slack delivery fails
deduplication: One opening event per stable problem and episode, and one verified recovery. No daily reminders or alerts for another run with the same unresolved problem.
coverage: Registered regression and release checks, plus current GitHub source, saved build, and deployed artifact evidence for the 28 catalog plugins. Unrecorded live skill behavior is not observable.
delivery_status: Existing task updated in place as Skill Check Alerts. Saved prompt matched, Hourly schedule and active state read back on 2026-11-02. Scheduled Slack event delivery remains unverified.
upstream_changes: Official-system release-note review and live compatibility tests remain separate maintenance work.

repair_preparation.mode: Prepare fixes on separate branches and open draft pull requests for Rachael's review.
repair_preparation.attempt_tracking: Save and read back a repair record on the candidate branch. Reuse the same issue key and budget across scheduled runs. Stop if the record is unavailable.
repair_preparation.validation: Confirm the current problem, use synthetic regression tests, and run the registered offline suite. Report unavailable validation explicitly.
repair_preparation.adoption: Rachael must approve merging. No auto-merge, direct main fixes, installed-copy updates, or production changes.
repair_preparation.status: Task instructions updated. No scheduled repair has yet been verified.
repair_preparation.notifications: Save repair progress in GitHub. No additional repair-ready or stopped-attempt notification; only the opening problem and verified recovery notify.

slack_delivery.content: Short status and GitHub evidence links; no client records or raw logs.
slack_delivery.deduplication: Use SKILL-CHECK:<event_id> from the durable event record. Reconcile a prior claim or uncertain send; never resend solely because a new run exists.

state.write_policy: Conditional revision update, claim before delivery, verified receipt after delivery. Missing state must not be reset.

plugin_sync.coverage: 28 existing saved private plugins and their full GitHub sources and deployed artifact records. Access loss is not recovery.
plugin_sync.anthropic: Do not submit, publish, or change Anthropic listings.
